title: Impact account
idea: Impact account: A small set of sourced measurements is presented with units, period and a visible explanation of what they do not prove.
audience: People who need to assess impact within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Visitors need to evaluate a claimed outcome quantitatively.
avoidWhen: Totals have no defensible source or denominator.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its assess impact priority and explicit commitment contract: Report source, freshness and uncertainty without unsupported causal claims.
navigation: Impact account keeps the current assess impact context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A small set of sourced measurements is presented with units, period and a visible explanation of what they do not prove.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to assess impact; visitors need to evaluate a claimed outcome quantitatively.
composition.priority: Report source, freshness and uncertainty without unsupported causal claims.

imagery.role: Support the actual assess impact context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize one measure at a time with text alternatives to charts.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the impact account structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no assess impact content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Report source, freshness and uncertainty without unsupported causal claims.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized assess impact content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Report source, freshness and uncertainty without unsupported causal claims.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active assess impact context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
